title: Project Manager Civil
description:
Salary Package: 50,000 - 60,000 per month
  
Elavathil Constructions is looking for an experienced and result-oriented Project Manager – Civil to plan, coordinate, and manage civil construction projects from commencement to completion. The ideal candidate should have strong project management, technical, billing, and team leadership skills, with the ability to ensure timely execution, cost control, quality standards, and compliance with approved drawings and specifications.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Plan, organize, and manage overall construction project activities from mobilization to completion.
  
  
2. Develop project schedules, work plans, resource allocation strategies, and execution timelines.
  
  
3. Coordinate with site engineers, supervisors, subcontractors, suppliers, consultants, clients, and departmental engineers.
  
  
4. Monitor project progress, identify delays, and implement corrective measures to ensure timely completion.
  
  
5. Oversee manpower planning, material procurement, machinery utilization, and subcontractor management.
  
  
6. Review and interpret structural, architectural, and engineering drawings, BOQs, and technical specifications.
  
  
7. Supervise project costing, quantity estimation, BOQ preparation, measurement verification, billing, and budget control.
  
  
8. Monitor project expenditure, material consumption, labour productivity, and cash flow to minimize costs and wastage.
  
  
9. Ensure compliance with approved drawings, contractual conditions, quality standards, safety procedures, and applicable regulations.
  
  
10. Manage client coordination, departmental approvals, work inspections, and resolution of technical and execution-related issues.
  
  
11. Review and verify running account bills, final bills, variation statements, and other project-related documentation.
  
  
12. Maintain project schedules, progress reports, financial records, material statements, and other essential documentation.
  
  
13. Lead, guide, and supervise site engineers, supervisors, and other project personnel to achieve project objectives.
  
  
14. Identify project risks and operational challenges and implement effective solutions.
  
  
15. Ensure proper project handover, completion documentation, and compliance with contractual obligations, including defect liability requirements.
  
  
Requirements
  
  
1. B.Tech/B.E. or Diploma in Civil Engineering.
  
  
2. Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in civil construction, preferably with experience managing multiple projects or large-scale works.
  
  
3. Strong knowledge of project planning, construction execution, quantity surveying, estimation, billing, and cost control.
  
  
4. Experience in Kerala Government/PWD works, including departmental procedures, measurement books (MB/EMB), running bills, and final billing, will be a strong advantage.
  
  
5. Ability to independently manage projects, lead teams, coordinate with stakeholders, and meet project deadlines.
  
  
6. Good knowledge of construction drawings, BOQs, specifications, contract conditions, and quality control procedures.
  
  
7. Proficiency in , MS Excel, MS Office, and project planning or construction management software.
  
  
8. Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  
  
9. Willingness to travel and stay at project locations as required.
  
  
Preferred Candidate A proactive and responsible professional capable of managing project operations, controlling costs, maintaining quality, coordinating teams, and ensuring the successful and timely completion of civil construction projects.
  
  
Join Elavathil Constructions and contribute to delivering quality construction projects with efficiency and professionalism.
  
  
Job Type: Full-time

title: Engineering Manager – PHP & Web Tech
description:
We are seeking an experienced Engineering Manager to lead software engineering teams, optimize delivery processes, and drive people development across multiple product teams. The role primarily focuses on engineering team management, delivery excellence, Agile execution, and stakeholder collaboration rather than hands-on development.

* Lead and manage software engineers and cross-functional teams to ensure timely, high-quality delivery.
* Drive sprint planning, roadmap execution, delivery tracking, and risk management.
* Coach engineers and Technical Leads, manage performance, and support career development.
* Monitor engineering KPIs, including DORA and SPACE metrics, to improve productivity and delivery predictability.
* Establish effective Agile practices, CI/CD workflows, release governance, and quality standards.
* Collaborate with Product, QA, DevOps, and senior leadership to resolve dependencies and delivery blockers.
* Promote team engagement, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Proven engineering management experience, including managing teams of 5+ engineers.
* Strong people leadership, mentoring, performance management, and conflict-resolution skills.
* Experience with Agile methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban.
* Knowledge of DORA metrics, engineering delivery KPIs, CI/CD, and software release processes.
* Experience managing cross-functional teams, delivery commitments, and stakeholder expectations.
* Strong communication and distributed-team management skills.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Previous experience in software development or technical leadership.
* Familiarity with PHP, Node.js, TypeScript, AWS, or API gateways.
* Experience with SaaS products, API-driven applications, and cloud-native platforms.
* Knowledge of SRE, platform reliability, and engineering process transformation.

title: SITE ENGINEER,PROPERTY CONSULTANT & PERSONAL SECRETARY
description:
**Company Description**
Builders is a construction and property services organization focused on delivering reliable, high-quality projects for residential and commercial clients. The company emphasizes strong technical execution, clear communication, and attention to detail across all phases of construction and property consulting. Team members collaborate closely with clients, contractors, and partners to ensure projects are completed safely, efficiently, and to specification. Builders values integrity, professionalism, and long-term relationships with clients and stakeholders.
  
**Role Description**
The SITE ENGINEER, PROPERTY CONSULTANT & PERSONAL SECRETARY role at Builders is an on-site position based in Kanayannur. This role combines technical supervision of construction activities, direct client interaction regarding property-related matters, and administrative support to senior leadership. Day-to-day tasks include monitoring site work, coordinating with civil engineers and contractors, ensuring quality control and compliance with structural specifications, and maintaining accurate project documentation. The role also involves advising clients on property options, organizing site visits, preparing basic reports and presentations, scheduling meetings, managing correspondence, and maintaining records. The position requires close coordination with multiple stakeholders to keep projects on track and support efficient decision-making.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong on-site supervision capabilities and familiarity with construction site practices.
* Candidates should possess effective communication skills for coordinating with clients, contractors, and internal teams.
* Candidates should possess quality control skills, including attention to detail and adherence to safety and regulatory standards.
* Candidates should possess structural engineering knowledge and the ability to work closely with civil engineers.
* Candidates should possess basic property consulting skills, including understanding of local real estate norms and client advisory needs.
* Candidates should possess organizational and administrative skills for scheduling, documentation, and report preparation.
* Relevant technical education in civil engineering or construction management is preferred.
* Prior experience in site engineering, property consulting, or executive support roles is beneficial.
* Proficiency in standard office software and basic project coordination tools is an advantage.
* Ability to work on-site in Kanayannur, manage multiple tasks, and maintain professional conduct in client-facing situations.

title: Civil Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Ocean Polymer Technologies Pvt. Ltd., established in 1998, is a leading provider of advanced plastic moulding solutions in South India, known for innovation, quality, and precision manufacturing. With state-of-the-art facilities in Tamil Nadu and Kerala, the company integrates Injection, Roto, and Extrusion Moulding technologies to serve both industrial and household markets.As an ISO-certified organization, it follows stringent quality protocols to meet international standards for strength, durability, and performance. The company is driven by engineering excellence, environmental responsibility, and customer trust, shaping new possibilities in plastic solutions.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Civil Engineer role based in the Thrissur district. The Civil Engineer will oversee planning, design, and execution of civil works related to manufacturing facilities, storage infrastructure, and associated utilities. Daily responsibilities include preparing and reviewing engineering drawings, coordinating with project teams and contractors, ensuring compliance with structural and safety standards, and managing site inspections. The role also involves supporting stormwater management, drainage design, and foundation works to ensure durability and efficiency of plant structures. The Civil Engineer will collaborate with production, maintenance, and quality teams to align civil projects with operational requirements.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Civil Engineering Diploma/ITI.
* Candidates should possess 2 year minimum experience
* Candidates should possess Planning skills for projects, resources, and timelines.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of Stormwater Management and related infrastructure design.
* Proficiency in CAD software and relevant civil design tools.
* Understanding of structural design codes, safety regulations, and quality standards.
* Ability to work on-site, manage multiple projects, and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
* Previous experience in industrial, plant, or infrastructure projects is an advantage.

title: Civil Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
KRFB is a public infrastructure organization focused on planning, developing, and maintaining road and transport projects in Kerala. The organization works closely with government and local stakeholders to deliver safe, reliable, and sustainable infrastructure that supports economic development and community needs. KRFB emphasizes quality engineering practices, regulatory compliance, and efficient project execution. Team members are encouraged to contribute to innovative solutions that improve connectivity and public experience across the region. The organization offers opportunities to work on impactful projects with clear social and environmental benefits.
  
**Role Description**
The Civil Engineer role at KRFB is a full-time, on-site position based in Alappuzha. The Civil Engineer will be responsible for designing and reviewing civil infrastructure projects, preparing drawings and specifications, and ensuring compliance with relevant standards and regulations. Daily tasks include planning project activities, coordinating with multidisciplinary teams and contractors, performing site inspections, and monitoring construction progress and quality. The role also involves analyzing stormwater management requirements, assessing structural and road design elements, preparing technical reports, and supporting project approvals and documentation. The Civil Engineer will collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, and within budget.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong proficiency in Civil Engineering Design and practical application of Civil Engineering principles.
* Experience working as Civil Engineers on infrastructure or transportation-related projects, preferably in public or government sectors.
* Demonstrated ability in project Planning, including scheduling, resource coordination, and documentation.
* Knowledge of Stormwater Management practices, drainage design, and relevant environmental and regulatory standards.
* Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Civil Engineering from an accredited institution.
* Familiarity with design and drafting software (e.g., AutoCAD, civil design tools) and basic project management software.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and site supervision skills, with attention to safety and quality control.
* Effective communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders.
* Valid professional registration or eligibility for registration with relevant engineering bodies is an advantage.

title: Factory Manager
description:
**ABOUT THE COMPANY**

K P Namboodiri's Ayurvedics (KPNA) is a heritage Ayurvedic products company founded in 1925, headquartered in Thrissur, Kerala. Oral care is its core category, with skin care and hair care as growth areas. The Company is strengthening its manufacturing and functional leadership to support its next phase of growth.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

The Factory Manager will run KPNA's personal care manufacturing unit at Vadakkekad, Thrissur. The role is accountable for production output, quality, cost, safety and people at the unit. It reports to the DGM, Operations. This is a hands-on role, based at the plant, with close involvement in daily shopfloor work.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Plant Operations**

•   
Run the day-to-day operations of the unit, covering production, maintenance, in-process quality checks and in-plant stores.

•   
Meet the monthly production plan for volume, quality and cost.

•   
Make good use of manpower, machines and materials across shifts.

•   
Keep production records, batch documents and daily reports accurate and up to date.

**2. Production Planning and Coordination**

•   
Prepare weekly and daily production schedules from the plan agreed with the DGM, Operations.

•   
Give material requirements to Supply Chain and Purchase on time, and flag shortages early.

•   
Coordinate with the Central Depot on the transfer of finished goods.

**3. Quality and Compliance**

•   
Make sure every batch is produced as per approved formulas, SOPs and Good Manufacturing Practice.

•   
Work with Quality Control on in-process checks, rejections and customer complaints, and close the root causes.

•   
Keep the plant ready for statutory and licensing inspections, and maintain the records these require.

**4. Maintenance and Hygiene**

•   
Plan and carry out preventive maintenance, and keep breakdowns and downtime low.

•   
Maintain hygiene and housekeeping standards suited to personal care manufacturing.

**5. Safety**

•   
Own workplace safety on the factory floor. This covers safe work practices, use of protective equipment, and reporting and follow-up of incidents.

**6. Cost and Improvement**

•   
Track and reduce wastage, rework and material loss.

•   
Suggest and carry out practical improvements to output, yield and changeover time.

**7. People**

•   
Lead supervisors and workers across shifts. Assign work, set daily targets and review progress.

•   
Assess manpower needs and raise requisitions through the DGM, Operations. HR handles recruitment, statutory welfare compliance and grievances.

•   
Train and develop supervisors to take on more responsibility.

**KEY SUCCESS METRICS**

•   
Adherence to the production plan

•   
Conversion cost per unit

•   
Wastage, rejection and rework levels

•   
First Pass Yield and customer complaints traced to manufacturing

•   
Machine downtime

•   
Safety incidents, and closure of inspection and audit observations

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

•   
Graduate in engineering, chemistry or pharmacy.

•   
10 to 15 years of manufacturing experience, with recent experience leading production.

•   
Experience in FMCG or related industries is preferred, but is not a pre-requisite for the right candidate.

•   
Working knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practice.

•   
Willing to be based in Thrissur. Knowledge of Malayalam is preferred.

**CAPABILITIES**

•   
Hands-on shopfloor leadership

•   
Production planning and scheduling

•   
Practical problem solving on quality and machine issues

•   
Awareness of cost and wastage

•   
Ability to train and manage a shopfloor team

•   
Clear and regular reporting

**WHY THIS ROLE**

The role offers full charge of an established plant making products for a brand with a century-old heritage. The Factory Manager will have a clear reporting line and defined support from Supply Chain, Quality Control and HR. There is room to grow as KPNA expands its manufacturing.

title: Snr BIM Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
RDS is a global team of experienced design, BIM, and engineering professionals specializing in fully coordinated, multi-disciplinary BIM projects. The team combines tier-one technical expertise with innovative digital construction technologies to deliver buildable, disciplined designs that improve onsite certainty and efficiency. By leveraging advanced virtual design tools, RDS enhances coordination, minimizes miscommunication, and enables clients to visualize projects before construction begins. With services spanning BIM, design development, planning and scheduling, documentation, estimating, logistics, and virtual design construction, RDS supports projects worldwide through robust communication and collaboration platforms. The company focuses on long-term value, using a “begin with the end in mind” approach to provide data that supports asset management throughout the lifecycle of built assets.

**Role Description**
The Snr BIM Engineer is a full-time, hybrid role based in Chalakkudy, with some flexibility for work from home. This role is responsible for leading and managing multi-disciplinary BIM models across architecture, civil, and MEP disciplines, ensuring accurate coordination and clash-free design solutions. Day-to-day responsibilities include developing detailed construction drawings and shop drawings, overseeing model integrity and standards, and collaborating with design and engineering teams to resolve technical issues. The Snr BIM Engineer will support project planning and scheduling through model-based workflows, contribute to quantity take-offs and documentation, and provide guidance to junior team members on BIM processes and best practices. The role also involves liaising with clients and internal stakeholders, ensuring timely delivery of BIM outputs and alignment with project objectives and industry standards.

**Qualifications**

* Strong proficiency in Building Information Modeling (BIM) tools and workflows, with proven experience in leading multi-disciplinary BIM projects.
* Ability to produce and review detailed Construction Drawings and Shop Drawings aligned with project specifications and local/international standards.
* Experience working with Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) systems in coordinated models, including clash detection and resolution.
* Background in Architecture and/or Civil Engineering with a solid understanding of structural, architectural, and building services integration.
* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Building Services, or a related discipline; advanced BIM or VDC certifications are an advantage.
* Proficiency in industry-standard BIM and design software (e.g., Revit, Navisworks, AutoCAD, and related coordination tools).
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and coordination skills, with attention to detail and an ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills, including experience working in cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.
* Experience in construction planning, sequencing, and model-based quantity take-off or estimation is beneficial.

title: QA Manager (Australia Migration GSM)
description:
**Job description:** 




 The Quality Assurance Manager is a senior function within ACET Migrations responsible for owning the full documentation quality lifecycle across Australian migration services. This role ensures every client file lodged by ACET Migrations meets the required accuracy, compliance, and regulatory standards set by Australian immigration authorities. The QA Manager leads the quality team, drives process consistency, and holds accountability for submission outcomes across all visa categories.
 



**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 1\. Setting the Quality Standard
 



 –Builds a clear system for how documents should be checked and approved
 



 –Sets the rules and targets the QA team works toward
 



 –Makes sure everyone on the team knows what good looks like and works to reach it
 



 –Steps in to help any team member who is struggling or unsure
 



 2\. Checking Files Before Submission
 



 –Reviews every file before it is sent to the immigration authority
 



 –Makes sure each file meets current Australian immigration requirements
 



 –Gives final approval — nothing gets lodged without QA sign\-off
 



 3\. Keeping Up With Immigration Rules
 



 –Stays on top of any changes to Australian immigration laws and guidelines
 



 –Updates the team quickly whenever rules change
 



 –Makes sure the team is always working with the most current requirements
 



 4\. Improving How Things Work
 



 –Creates clear step\-by\-step processes for the team to follow
 



 –Spots where things are going wrong and fixes them properly
 



 –Makes sure the same mistakes do not keep happening
 



 5\. Reducing Errors and Rejections
 



 –Tracks where errors and rejections are coming from
 



 –Investigates every rejection to understand why it happened
 



 –Puts steps in place so the same issue does not happen again
 



 –Works toward getting files right the first time, every time
 



 6\. Reporting to Leadership
 



 –Keeps track of how each team member and the overall team is performing
 



 –Prepares clear reports on submission quality, errors, and trends
 



 –Shares findings and suggestions with senior management regularly
 



 7\. Working With Other Teams
 



 –Works alongside case managers, migration agents, and operations staff
 



 –Makes sure quality is not just a QA job — it runs through the whole business
 



 –Gets involved in cases that are complicated or carry higher risk
 



 8\. Training the Team
 



 –Runs training sessions to help the team improve their documentation skills
 



 –Teaches the team about any new immigration rules or process changes
 



 –Builds a team culture where everyone cares about quality, not just the QA Manager
 



 9\. Protecting Client Information
 



 –Makes sure all client data is handled safely and kept private
 



 –Follows all legal and company rules around data protection
 



**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 –Has a relevant degree
 



 –Has 3 to 5 years or more working in Australian migration services
 



 –Has led a QA or compliance team for at least 2 to 3 years
 



 –Knows Australian immigration visa types and what each one requires
 



 –Has used case management or CRM systems before
 



 –Experience across PR, work visas, and student visas is a bonus
 



 Work Location: In person
